name: The Good Ending
source:
Our beloved protagonist has awoken to the true nature of his reality. Whether he’s ready for it or not, he is the only one who has the power to save everyone. Joining the Literature Club for the second time isn’t easy. How do you face the friends you watched die, knowing they won’t remember a second of it?

Help MC as he explores his new reality and does whatever he can to set things right. He can’t do it alone — but at least he has you.

[From [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/the-good-ending]DokiMods[/url]]
translation:
我们亲爱的主人公，已经觉察到了自己所处现实的真相。无论是否做好准备，只有他拥有拯救所有人的力量。第二次加入文学部绝非易事。面对那些自己曾亲眼看着死去、却对此毫无记忆的朋友，该如何自处？

帮助主人公探索这片全新的现实，竭尽所能让一切重回正轨。他无法独自做到——但至少，他还有你。

[摘自[url=https://dokimods.me/mods/the-good-ending]DokiMods[/url]]
